_about: The how-to-play board at each puzzle's start switch (IsleKit.StartCorner). tools/howto_art.py paints one picture a puzzle from this into unity/Assets/Textures/HowTo/. Keep a line under about 40 letters and a board to five lines: it is read from a few metres. Say what to do, in the order a player does it.

AdventTrail.title: Advent Trail
lines: The board shows five pictures.
Their parcels wait in post boxes:
follow the fingerposts to find them.
Hang each under its picture.
Then press the check button.

BaubleHunt.title: Bauble Hunt
lines: The board shows three wanted baubles.
The baubles in the wood look blank:
only the tower's telescope reads them.
Hang the three in order.
Then press the check button.

BellRingers.title: Bell Ringers
lines: The lamps ring a peal.
Step on the mats in the same order.
Each round adds a bell: 3, 4, 5, 6.
The big mat needs two ringers at once.
A slip plays the round again.

BigAir.title: Big Air
lines: Take skis from the rack.
Ride off the kicker
and fly through a window.
Its lamp lights: it counts once.
Fly through all three.

BlindCarols.title: Blind Carols
lines: Each bell cote plays a carol.
One player wears the blindfold
and sorts the tune tiles by ear.
Friends call each slot's colour.
Then press the check button.

BlindSculptor.title: Blind Sculptor
lines: One player wears the blindfold.
The others see the five wanted tiles
and talk the sculptor to each one.
Hang them in order.
Then press the check button.

BlizzardWalk.title: Blizzard Walk
lines: One alcove in the maze is lit.
The crow's nest shows which.
Stand in it for a moment:
another one lights.
Find five.

Downhill.title: Downhill
lines: Take skis from the rack.
Ski through the start gate.
Each row has one lit gate:
two skiers must pass it together.
Six rows, then the finish.

FairyLights.title: Fairy Lights
lines: Each post has a button.
It flips that post's lamp
and the lamp on either side.
Light all seven.

Footprints.title: Footprints
lines: One player wears the blindfold
and goes through the turnstile.
The guide in the cab reads the far
lamp board and calls the way to the
lit pad. Find six.

GlassBooth.title: Glass Booth
lines: The Reader in the booth sees five
pictures, and can only point.
The Spotter takes the tiles pointed at
to the Keeper's hatch. The Keeper hangs
them by the dots. Four minutes.

HoldTheStar.title: Hold the Star
lines: Hold every star button at once.
The box opens while all are held.
One more player lifts the gourd out.
Let go and it shuts.

LightTheTree.title: Light the Tree
lines: A lamp lights in the next shelter
along, over a picture. Call it out!
Whoever has that picture
presses the button under it.
Eight in a row light the tree.

Lookouts.title: Lookouts
lines: Take a radio. Lookouts walk the way
the flags point, to the beacons,
and call their pictures back.
The Keeper hangs the matching tiles.
Then all pull their levers together.

MidnightFinale.title: Midnight Finale
lines: The Caller in the Firing Room
describes the picture by the lit lamp.
The firer with that picture holds
its button. Twelve clean calls,
then all pull their levers together.

RadioSilence.title: Radio Silence
lines: Pictures are split between the Hut
and the Booth. Voices go one way:
sit in a chair to hear the room before.
The Signalman hangs all five tiles
and presses check. Five minutes.

ReindeerCount.title: Reindeer Count
lines: Some reindeer noses are glowing.
Each gallery sees part of the shed.
Count them all, enter the number
and press the check button.
A miss lights a new set.

SantasList.title: Santa's List
lines: Two lists of five pictures hang
far apart: one here, one down the
hall (use the telescope).
They differ in two places.
Mark those two, then press check.

Slalom.title: Slalom
lines: Take skis from the rack.
Ski through the start arch.
One lane of each row is lit:
ski through it.
Six rows, then the finish arch.

SleighRun.title: Sleigh Run
lines: Four presents wait in the workshop.
Pass them through the hatches,
room to room, into the sleigh.
Presents cannot go
through the turnstiles.

SnowBridge.title: Snow Bridge
lines: Carry snow blocks to the cradle
beside each gap.
Three blocks in a cradle
raise its span.
Reach the far bank.

SnowGlobe.title: Snow Globe
lines: The Reader reads the far shop's
pictures by telescope and calls them
to the Relay at the lectern. Only the
Relay is heard in the globe, where the
Keeper hangs the tiles. Seven minutes.

SnowballRange.title: Snowball Range
lines: Throw a snowball into each basket.
A basket's lamp lights
when it has been hit.
All six baskets win.

Snowman.title: Snowman
lines: Nine snowballs lie round the fort.
Each plot needs a large,
a medium and a small one.
Build all three snowmen.

StockingSort.title: Stocking Sort
lines: Hang a present over each stocking.
The lamps show how many are right,
never which ones.
Swap presents and look again
until all five are right.

SummitShot.title: Summit Shot
lines: The thrower cannot see the baskets.
The spotter on the deck can: talk!
Lob snowballs over the wall.
Hit each of the four baskets once.

ThinIce.title: Thin Ice
lines: One player wears the blindfold
and walks out on the ice.
The guide on the tower reads the map
and calls the way to the lit floe.
Reach six floes.

WhisperingChimney.title: Whispering Chimney
lines: Each chimney plays a tune at its hearth.
Each tile plays a tune too.
Hang the matching tile
in each chimney's colour.
Then press the check button.

WhiteoutMaze.title: Whiteout Maze
lines: Standing on a coloured plate holds
a gate open somewhere else.
Take turns holding and walking.
Reach the star
beyond the third gate.
